newsitem.title: FRANCE: French riot police evict striking bus drivers.
newsitem.headline: French riot police evict striking bus drivers.

text.p: French riot police evicted striking bus drivers from a depot in the southwestern city of Toulouse on Monday, angering unions with a rare use of force to resolve a labour dispute, witnesses said.
Three protesters were slightly injured when about 60 police made a lightning raid to clear the Langlade bus depot, blocked since dawn, a spokesman for the pro-Socialist CFDT union said.

The police took up positions around the depot, one of two in the city, to clear the way for non-strikers to drive in and out. The other depot was still blocked by strikers who had called on all drivers to observe a three-hour stoppage in the city.
The bus drivers accuse management of failing to implement what they reckon was a promise to cut the retirement age to 55 and introduce a 35-hour week after a previous strike in December.
